verdict.rationale: The only evidence of benchmark backing is founder statements relayed on HN: 87% answer accuracy on HotpotQA with human labeling, and 'almost 90%' on unnamed 'standard industry benchmarks.' No first-party docs page, methodology, or reproducible results are in the pack. Missing for 10: official published benchmark results in Cognee's docs, memory-specific benchmarks such as LongMemEval or LoCoMo, methodology and reproducible scripts, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can see published memory-quality benchmark results (e.g. LongMemEval, LoCoMo) backing the product's recall-accuracy claims

citations.quote: testing on HotpotQA with human labeling achieved 87% answer accuracy using Cognee's ECL pipeline approach with FalkorDB integration
reached almost 90% on standard industry benchmarks
